name: code-tracer-test-evidence-demo
description: Evidence tooling for the test-evidence demo: runs every test category against the Java product, converts results to CTRF/SARIF/OSV, signs in-toto attestations, and runs the gate.

scripts.signoffs: node evidence/signoff.mjs --category ux-signoff --reviewer alice.chen --result PASSED --evidence tests/ux/findings.md && node evidence/signoff.mjs --category uat-signoff --reviewer raj.patel --result PASSED --evidence tests/uat/signoff-notes.md
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run evidence && npm run signoffs && npm run policy:test && npm run gate && npm run gate:negative
